title: Farm Sim 100% made with AI - 6h build so far
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
Hello everyone,

I posted my Diablo 2 build yesterday, and thought I'd share some more games I'm trying to build (with the correct flair this time),

This is a farm simulator where the goal is to survive 10 nights, and build up your farm with plants, animals and food to survive. I started this morning and this is how far I am so far

Happy so share some prompts that got me started! (I'll post an update later on my Diablo 2 ARPG progress)

comments.author: thirsty_pretzelzz
comments.body:
For 6 hours in it looks amazing..

Are assets from an asset pack? Also how are you handling the animations and shadows? Feel like you’re got a great workflow if you nailed all that in 6h

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body:
Thank you! 

The assets are generated using Tripo mostly (integrated into Tesana), for the animations and shadows that’s also handled by the engine - this is all from just prompting the engine in the chat, being very specific in what I want

Honestly I’m just sitting with the AI and watch it work, give it the next things to fix, and so on - I need to improve the animals a bit since some of only have two legs lol

replies.author: EshopExpert
replies.body:
How many tris does your models have?

Is the game running at 10fps?

comments.author: Badestrand
comments.body: Which engine? It looks so cute, what did you prompt to get that look?

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body:
The whole thing is built in Tesana: [https://tesana.ai/en](https://tesana.ai/en),

My first prompt was rather simple: farm sim game with a green, cel-shade style styling - the player starts with a small red farm and a few animals, and the character should be cute and wear a hat.

That gave me the base that I started iterating from

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: this was the exact prompt I started with: ***I want a cute, top down farm sim where im building a farm, herding animals and growing plants - while trying to stay alive at night from dangerous beasts***

comments.body: Good is this a Unity Engie Clone? And have you this code

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: This was built in Tesana (linked further down), yeah - I can export the code if I want

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body:
Chunk loading, Pre loading and Cashing, And A quick duplicate sniff your performance will skyrocket! Really cool project!! 

Btw id suggest looking in to each before prompting if you are unfamiliar with the concepts and it should yield should get pretty good results

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Awesome feedback, thanks - I’m gonna check all of those things out 🫡

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: Np!

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Tesana isn't an LLM, it's an engine - so not an LLM or diffusion model like Genie 3. It's a code based engine where you use natural language to tell the engine what to build for you.

replies.author: Revelation12Studios
replies.body: Interesting. It doesn’t use any LLM to write the code?

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: It's using Anthropic and OpenAI models for the code - but the code isn't really the hard part, its the game logic and connecting all the different things that make the game "run" - this is where the engine comes in

replies.author: Revelation12Studios
replies.body: Cool! I tried it to make a game, and when the loading bar got to full it crashed every time (I am on mobile).

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Ah yeah mobile is still a bit wonky - patching it over the weekend to make it much more stable and smooth. If you want to try it before then, desktop is definately best! DM me and I can add some credits to your account if you want :)
